podcast.body: This song became extremely risky to sing in karaoke establishments in the Philippines after January 16, 1998, when someone was killed over its performance. Since then, about a dozen people have been murdered in disputes related to karaoke performances of "My Way," leading to many Filipino karaoke bars no longer offering it and many Filipinos avoiding it due to the associated stories. "In January 16, 1998, someone was killed over their performance of My Way by Frank Sinatra."
